# Piemme Nord Oftalmica

> Piemme Nord Oftalmica, a brand of Piemme S.r.l., distributes and services ophthalmic equipment for eye care professionals in Northern Italy. It is a reseller in Italy of SBM Sistemi (ocular surface and dry eye disease diagnostics, instruments such as the OS1000 and LUNA X) and the exclusive partner in Northern Italy of Optopol Technology (OCT systems such as the REVO HR, OCT angiography (OCTA) and ophthalmic imaging).

The website is intended for healthcare professionals. It is available in Italian and English.

## Services

- Expert advice on choosing ophthalmic technologies
- Sale of selected ophthalmic equipment (SBM Sistemi, Optopol)
- Technical support: support, maintenance, repairs and updates
- Pre-owned professional equipment: take-back, valuation and management
- Training (Piemme Academy): courses at our premises and upon request, demonstrations, hands-on training in the use of equipment and software

## Who it serves

- Ophthalmologists: advanced dry eye diagnostics and OCT imaging to support refractive and cataract surgery, clinical management and follow-up
- Opticians and optometrists: dry eye and keratoconus screening in optical retail settings
- Advanced aesthetic medicine: ocular wellbeing and treatments integrated into dry eye care

## In italiano

Piemme Nord Oftalmica, marchio di Piemme S.r.l., distribuisce e assiste strumenti oftalmici per i professionisti della visione in Nord Italia: rivenditore per l'Italia di SBM Sistemi (diagnosi del Dry Eye e della superficie oculare, strumenti come OS1000 e LUNA X) ed esclusivista per il Nord Italia di Optopol Technology (OCT come REVO HR, angio-OCT e imaging oftalmico). Offre consulenza specialistica, assistenza tecnica, gestione dell'usato professionale e formazione (Piemme Academy). Sede operativa a Sommacampagna (VR).
